response.sql: WITH source_stats AS (SELECT p.fundflux, COUNT(*) AS spatial_count, AVG(s.boxy / NULLIF(s.boxz, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM scanspatial AS s JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(spatial_count) AS avg_count FROM source_stats) SELECT AVG(ss.avg_ratio) AS avg_kept_ratio, SUM(ss.spatial_count) AS total_spatial_count, AVG(ss.spatial_count - b.avg_count) AS avg_count_excess FROM source_stats AS ss CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE ss.spatial_count > b.avg_count;

assumptions.assumption: The cross-source average includes funding sources represented by at least one spatial record. A zero boxz makes that record's ratio undefined and is excluded from the ratio average.

alternatives.interpretation: Include funding sources belonging only to projects with no spatial records, giving those sources a count of zero in the cross-source average.
